- **数据缺失说明**：由于合同台账和9月已确认销售数据缺失，无法计算目标完成度；环比数据因查询报错暂缺。

WITH aug AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS aug_stock FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-08-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-08-31' GROUP BY rf.sku), sep AS (SELECT rf.sku, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS sep_stock FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_end >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' GROUP BY rf.sku) SELECT COALESCE(s.sku, a.sku) AS sku, p.product_name_en, a.aug_stock, s.sep_stock, (s.sep_stock - a.aug_stock) AS change FROM sep AS s FULL OUTER JOIN aug AS a ON a.sku = s.sku LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = COALESCE(s.sku, a.sku) ORDER BY sku LIMIT 100
SELECT po_number, status, total_amount, eta_date FROM purchase_orders WHERE status <> 'completed' ORDER BY po_number LIMIT 100

WITH rev AS (SELECT SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS fact_count FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE rf.status = 'confirmed' AND sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.metric_key = 'revenue' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30'), tgt AS (SELECT c.id, c.annual_sales_target, c.annual_sales_target_currency FROM contracts AS c WHERE c.status = 'active' ORDER BY c.effective_from DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) SELECT rev.revenue, rev.fact_count, tgt.annual_sales_target, tgt.annual_sales_target_currency, CASE WHEN NOT tgt.annual_sales_target IS NULL THEN rev.revenue / NULLIF(CAST((tgt.annual_sales_target ->> 'amount') AS DECIMAL), 0) END AS completion_ratio FROM rev, tgt

SELECT po.po_number, po.status, po.submitted_at, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(i.line_total) AS total_amount FROM purchase_orders AS po LEFT JOIN purchase_order_items AS i ON i.po_id = po.id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY po.id, po.po_number, po.status, po.submitted_at ORDER BY po.submitted_at LIMIT 100

WITH facts AS (SELECT rf.sku, rf.metric_key, SUM(rf.numeric_value) AS total FROM report_facts AS rf JOIN sales_reports AS sr ON sr.id = rf.report_id WHERE sr.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.status = 'confirmed' AND rf.period_start >= '2026-09-01' AND rf.period_end <= '2026-09-30' AND rf.metric_key IN ('stock_on_hand', 'units_sold') GROUP BY rf.sku, rf.metric_key) SELECT f.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'stock_on_hand' THEN f.total END) AS ending_stock, MAX(CASE WHEN f.metric_key = 'units_sold' THEN f.total END) AS units_sold FROM facts AS f LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.sku = f.sku GROUP BY f.sku, p.product_name_en, p.product_name_native ORDER BY f.sku LIMIT 100

WITH po AS (SELECT id FROM purchase_orders WHERE submitted_at >= '2026-09-01' AND submitted_at < '2026-10-01') SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(i.line_total) AS total_amount, CAST(SUM(i.quantity) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(i.quantity)) OVER (), 0) AS quantity_share FROM purchase_order_items AS i JOIN po ON po.id = i.po_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 100

WITH base AS (SELECT p.category, TO_CHAR(po.submitted_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS ym, poi.quantity, poi.line_total FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN purchase_order_items AS poi ON poi.po_id = po.id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = poi.product_id WHERE po.submitted_at >= '2026-08-01' AND po.submitted_at < '2026-10-01'), agg AS (SELECT category, SUM(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS aug_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS sep_cases, SUM(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-08' THEN line_total ELSE 0 END) AS aug_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN ym = '2026-09' THEN line_total ELSE 0 END) AS sep_amount FROM base GROUP BY category) SELECT category, aug_cases, sep_cases, sep_cases - aug_cases AS cases_change, CASE WHEN aug_cases = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((CAST((sep_cases - aug_cases) AS DECIMAL) / aug_cases) * 100, 2) END AS cases_change_pct, aug_amount, sep_amount, sep_amount - aug_amount AS amount_change, CASE WHEN aug_amount = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(((sep_amount - aug_amount) / aug_amount) * 100, 2) END AS amount_change_pct FROM agg ORDER BY category LIMIT 100
